title: Owner Notes
description: Local-only example module. Saves one note in its own private data directory; no TV settings or network access.
disableDescription: Removes this example's activation marker and stops its actions. Your saved note stays in the module's data directory; turning the module off does not erase it.
publisher: Unknown Digital and Unknown Suite contributors
permissions: Runs as root; the host does not enforce this module's declared scope
Writes only its own note and activation marker; retains the note when disabled

status.title: Read note
status.description: Displays the note currently saved locally on this TV and whether this example module is active. Nothing is uploaded.

saveNote.title: Save note
saveNote.description: Replaces the one saved note with the text below. It stays local and is retained when the module is disabled.

note.title: Replacement note
note.description: Enter up to 500 characters. Saving replaces the previous note; it does not append another entry.

clearNote.title: Clear note
clearNote.description: Erases the saved note. It does not disable the module or change any TV settings.

confirmation.message: Confirm deleting the saved note. This cannot be undone.
